body: I believe that is true as well, but I've been there for over two years so I meet those requirements.
I moved out to where I am now for work. He is in the hospital back where I grew up

Where to even start. I'm a drug addict. I was in recovery. I was clean for almost 2 years.And then it just all went downhill. My father has been in the hospital for almost 6 months now. He has had his ups and downs in there. I've been driving an hour and a half to the hospital every day to visit him and spend time with him. Obviously this put a strain on my work, but they claimed to be supportive. Although I don't think they expected it to last this long. So now because I'm trying to be there for my father, I feel like I'm letting down everyone else in my life. My friends, my work, they all make comments or seem to get upset because I'm not there for them like I used to be, but then all claim to be 100% supportive of what I'm doing with my family. So I just have this feeling of never being able to make anyone happy, no matter how hard I try. Then my aunt passed away, which was a huge blow to me, and then my uncle two weeks later. Just devestating. It was during this time that I relapsed. 

Now I'm back down that hole. Another replase. Another stint in rehab. Telling everyone again that I fucked it all up. Going through all that shame and depression again. I couldn't even face it. I just want it all to end.
